morphology_outputs.design_calculations: Carbon fiber chassis (60kg) + steel front plate (25kg) + 4 rubber wheels (15kg each) = 145kg total.
morphology_outputs.overview: Low-profile 4-wheel differential-drive pusher with steel ramming plate and rubber wheels for traction.
morphology_outputs.movement: Four hinge-joint wheels with gear=2500. Left pair (motor_fl+motor_rl) and right pair (motor_fr+motor_rr) for differential steering.
morphology_outputs.attack: Steel front plate acts as a battering ram. Edge-scaled push power near arena boundary.
morphology_outputs.defense: Asymmetric edge safety: push through when opponent is between us and edge, retreat when heading toward edge alone.

actuator_outputs.strategy_plan: Pure reactive controller. Speed-limited approach, full push on contact, asymmetric edge safety.
actuator_outputs.movement_logic: Differential drive: left_pair = throttle - turn, right_pair = throttle + turn. Heading error drives steering. Max approach speed 1.5 m/s.
actuator_outputs.attack_logic: On contact, push with power scaled by edge distance (1.0 far, 0.4 at edge). Keeps pushing when opponent is between us and edge.
actuator_outputs.defense_logic: Asymmetric edge safety: full retreat when near edge without opponent ahead. Emergency brake at 1.8m edge distance. Only 1.0m brake when actively pushing opponent toward edge.

metadata.description: Active pusher baseline for ELO calibration — reactive 4-wheel drive, ~76% WR vs stationary block
